visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with shoulder-length brown hair, wearing a cream-colored crochet-knit sweater and blue denim jeans, stands in the center of a minimalist living room. She smiles warmly at the camera, her facial expressions animated as she speaks. Her hands gesture frequently to emphasize her points. The background features white walls, light-toned wooden cabinets, and a digital clock. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a well-lit indoor home environment. (2) The scene cuts to a sequence of close-up shots showing traditional ritual items on a dark reflective surface, likely a temple altar. Several red incense sticks are bundled together, alongside packs of golden spirit paper. A plate of fresh fruits, including bright red apples, yellow bananas, and a lime, is neatly arranged. There are also several packs of traditional snacks and bottled beverages. The lighting here is slightly more focused, highlighting the textures of the fruit and packaging. (3) The camera returns to the woman standing in front of a light wood shelf. She points towards various household pantry items. On the shelf, there are bags of rice, a large bottle of cooking oil, a package of salt, and several bottles of soy sauce and vinegar. She uses her fingers to count as she lists these items. The background remains consistent with the previous indoor home setting, appearing clean and organized. (4) A close-up view shows a table stacked with multiple white ceramic bowls, small plates, and bundles of wooden chopsticks. A framed piece of art depicting various vase shapes hangs on the wall behind the items. The woman’s hand enters the frame holding a sheet of small red circular stickers. She peels one off and carefully presses it onto the side of a white bowl. This close-up highlights the meticulous nature of the ritual preparation. (5) The woman is back on screen, now holding a yellow box of kitchenware from the brand 'kakaii'. She shows the camera a set of packaged spatulas, ladles, and a cutting board laid out on a table. Her expression is enthusiastic as she reviews the items. The background shows a spacious, sunlit living area with a large balcony door and a gray sofa, suggesting a modern high-rise apartment. (6) A brief cutaway shows a group of about six people, including elderly adults and two young children, sitting around a large white dining table. They are engaged in a shared meal, with various dishes spread out before them. The atmosphere appears festive and warm. The camera is at eye-level, capturing the social interaction from a slight distance. (7) The camera pans up to show a sequence of minimalist ceiling lights. Bright white recessed spotlights and LED strip lighting along the ceiling edges are turned on, illuminating a white hallway and part of a room. This phase emphasizes the 'lighting up' step of the ritual. The walls are plain white, reflecting the bright light. (8) A low-angle handheld shot follows the woman's hand as it sweeps across a clean, light-colored wood-laminate floor. She gestures towards the corners of the room and the base of a wooden cabinet. The floor appears spotless, emphasizing the importance of thorough cleaning before moving in. (9) Back to a medium shot of the woman speaking to the camera. Behind her, a stainless steel kettle sits on a black glass-top gas stove. She continues her explanation with high energy, her hands moving in small circles. The kitchen setting is modern, with white cabinets and a clean countertop. (10) This phase consists of multiple close-up shots of kitchen activities. First, the kettle is seen on the stove as water begins to boil. Next, a package of 'Gui Guan' brand frozen tangyuan is shown, followed by the pink and white dumplings simmering in a pot of brown syrup. Finally, a stainless steel bowl filled with clear water and several gold-colored coins is shown. The woman’s hand holds a small plastic bag filled with more coins. (11) A shot of a bedroom area where a light wood bed frame with a white mattress and gray pillows is being pushed into place against a wood-paneled wall. The room is bright, with large windows and neutral-colored curtains visible in the background. This visualizes the 'setting the bed' ritual step. (12) The final scene shows the woman sitting comfortably on a tan leather sofa. She looks directly into the lens, concluding her tutorial with a friendly smile. She gestures towards the camera and finally waves both hands in a 'bye-bye' motion, followed by a double peace sign. The background shows a portion of the living room, maintaining the bright, domestic aesthetic.
